This protein, in turn, is targeted by (-)-Rosmarinic Acid, which is known to interact with ZR-75-1. The final score of 0.5095 indicates a moderate level of confidence in the relationship, suggesting that Trisnor-Gamma-Lactone may modulate ZR-75-1 through the Mcl-1 pathway. The evidence is consistent with a mechanistic link, but the strength of the interaction remains uncertain, as it is based on a single score and lacks direct experimental validation. The pathway is supported by multiple layers of molecular interaction, but further studies are needed to confirm the role of Trisnor-Gamma-Lactone in regulating ZR-75-1.
